title: Concept: go.mod with no module path
description: go.mod declares a module file that declares no module path, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module file that declares no module path.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module file that declares no module path.
